fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-Criminal Record Certificate issued by the police or former school. * 2. Medical examination form issued by hospitals. You can download a template or sample from here . 3. Applicants for Music, Dance, Performance, Fine Arts programs should submit at least 5 art works or videos. * 4. Certificate of HSK * 5. Scanned copy of the passport (main page of the passport, in JPG, PNG or PDF format) * 6. Recent photo (passport size, in JPG or PNG format) * 7. Scanned copy of the senior high school diploma Applicants who are about to graduate should provide a certificate of impending graduation with the estimated graduation time on it from their current academic institution. In this case, the actural diploma should be submitted before August 31, 2023. * 8. Scanned copy of complete senior high school academic transcripts Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Applicants who have already taken courses in universities or colleges should also provide the university/college transcripts. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1) Aged 16 years or above, in good health conditions 2) Non-Chinese citizen: as required by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC. 3) Senior high school graduate 4) Chinese language requirements: Valid HSK test report should be submitted. a. Chinese Language Program & Program of Teaching Chinese to the Speakers of Other Languages (for international students only): New HSK 4 ≥180 b. Arts programs: New HSK 4 ≥180 (no less than 60 in each module) c. Sciences & engineering programs: New HSK 4 ≥195 (no less than 65 in each module) d. Humanities, economics & management programs: New HSK 4 ≥210 (no less than 70 in each module) Applicants who hold the following certifications are not required of HSK test reports: a. SAT II Chinese with Listening, score≥600 b. IB Chinese HL Course, score≥6 c. A-level Chinese Course, score≥A d. AP Chinese Course or relevant certifications e. High school education offered in Chinese f . CSC pre-college certificate obtained
